traits: Headlines slam into place with a visible overshoot, and a figure punches in rather than counting up.
A new element arrives about every second; no scene holds longer than a beat or two.
Body text arrives word by word, a few hundredths of a second apart.
Cuts are hard, or a push or whip-pan that carries the speed of the move into the next scene.

notLike.line: stop-motion also slams, but it animates on threes so each move steps in visible frames; kinetic is fluid at full frame rate.
proof reuses kinetic's entrances but has no overshoot and cuts hard everywhere; kinetic bounces and lets a whip-pan carry a scene out.

nativeMoves.move: The whip-pan climax: the camera streaks out of one scene at the speed the last move had, and the next lands already moving.
nativeMoves.transfer: A trailer for a product drop where the last feature whips off to the price.

nativeMoves.move: Word-by-word body copy over a slammed headline, so the sentence is read at the speed it is shown.
nativeMoves.transfer: A recruitment film where each line of the pitch lands one word at a time under a one-word headline.

nativeMoves.move: A figure punched in at oversize and settling to its size.
nativeMoves.transfer: A fundraising film where the total raised hits the frame, then shrinks to sit in the line.

pitfalls.mistake: Holding scenes for two seconds or more.
pitfalls.mechanism: The hold floor is under a second, so a long still frame breaks the pulse and the film drags between slams.
pitfalls.fix: Split the scene into two or three beats, or add a camera move.

pitfalls.mistake: Slamming every element in the scene.
pitfalls.mechanism: With all elements overshooting at once nothing stands out, and the overshoot reads as shake.
pitfalls.fix: Slam the headline only; let body words and plates take the quieter entrances.

pitfalls.mistake: Mixing a push or whip-pan with a crossfade in the same film.
pitfalls.mechanism: Velocity-matched cuts rely on the next scene starting at the speed the last ended; a dissolve resets that to zero.
pitfalls.fix: Stay with hard cuts, push and whip-pan.

free: Which scene takes the whip-pan, within the climax role.
How many words arrive per group in the body copy.
Which figure is punched and which counts up.
invariants: No crossfade or dip between scenes.
Arrivals stay between five and ten per ten seconds.
